mapper.insert:
SELECT LAST_INSERT_ID()
INSERT INTO transactions ( wallet_id, recipient_id, merchant_id, account_id, type, initiated_by, amount, memo, balance_after, status, latitude, longitude, pg_payment_key, risk_score, created_at, completed_at ) VALUES ( #{walletId}, #{recipientId}, #{merchantId}, #{accountId}, #{type}, #{initiatedBy}, #{amount}, #{memo}, #{balanceAfter}, #{status}, #{latitude}, #{longitude}, #{pgPaymentKey}, #{riskScore}, #{createdAt}, #{completedAt} )
mapper.update: update transactions set status = 'FAILED' where transaction_id = #{transactionId} and status = 'REQUESTED'
mapper.select: SELECT t.transaction_id AS transactionId, w.user_id AS wardId, u.name AS wardName, t.amount AS amount, t.created_at AS createdAt FROM transactions t JOIN wallets w ON t.wallet_id = w.wallet_id JOIN users u ON w.user_id = u.user_id WHERE t.type = 'CHARGE' AND t.initiated_by = #{guardId} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC

SELECT t.transaction_id, w.user_id AS ward_id, u.name AS ward_name, t.amount, t.memo, t.account_id, b.bank_code, b.bank_name, a.account_no, t.created_at, t.balance_after FROM transactions t JOIN wallets w ON t.wallet_id = w.wallet_id JOIN users u ON w.user_id = u.user_id LEFT JOIN linked_accounts a ON t.account_id = a.account_id LEFT JOIN banks b ON a.bank_code = b.bank_code WHERE t.type = 'CHARGE' AND t.transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND t.initiated_by = #{guardId}

SELECT t.transaction_id AS transactionId, t.wallet_id AS walletId, w.user_id AS userId, t.recipient_id AS recipientId, r.bank_code AS bankCode, b.bank_name AS bankName, r.account_no AS accountNo, r.holder_name AS holderName, t.amount AS amount, t.memo AS memo FROM transactions t JOIN wallets w ON t.wallet_id = w.wallet_id JOIN recipients r ON t.recipient_id = r.recipient_id JOIN banks b ON r.bank_code = b.bank_code WHERE t.transaction_id = #{transactionId}

SELECT t.transaction_id AS transactionId, CASE WHEN t.type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' THEN 'TRANSFER' ELSE t.type END AS type, t.status AS status, CASE t.type WHEN 'CHARGE' THEN b.bank_name WHEN 'PAYMENT' THEN m.name WHEN 'TRANSFER_OUT' THEN r.holder_name END AS counterpartyName, t.amount AS amount, re.risk_level AS riskLevel, ( SELECT rr.description FROM risk_evaluation_details red JOIN risk_rules rr ON rr.rule_id = red.rule_id WHERE red.evaluation_id = re.evaluation_id ORDER BY red.score DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS riskReason, t.created_at AS createdAt FROM transactions t JOIN wallets w ON w.wallet_id = t.wallet_id JOIN guard_senior gs ON gs.senior_id = w.user_id AND gs.status = 'ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN recipients r ON r.recipient_id = t.recipient_id LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = t.merchant_id LEFT JOIN linked_accounts la ON la.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN banks b ON b.bank_code = la.bank_code LEFT JOIN risk_evaluations re ON re.transaction_id = t.transaction_id WHERE gs.guard_id = #{guardId} AND w.user_id = #{wardId} AND t.initiated_by IS NULL AND t.type = #{type} AND re.risk_level = #{riskLevel} ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.transaction_id, CASE t.type WHEN 'TRANSFER_OUT' THEN 'TRANSFER' ELSE t.type END AS type, t.status, CASE t.type WHEN 'TRANSFER_OUT' THEN r.holder_name WHEN 'PAYMENT' THEN m.name WHEN 'CHARGE' THEN b.bank_name END AS counterparty_name, t.amount, re.risk_level, ( SELECT rr.description FROM risk_evaluation_details red JOIN risk_rules rr ON rr.rule_id = red.rule_id WHERE red.evaluation_id = re.evaluation_id ORDER BY red.score DESC LIMIT 1 ) AS risk_reason, t.created_at FROM transactions t JOIN wallets w ON w.wallet_id = t.wallet_id LEFT JOIN recipients r ON r.recipient_id = t.recipient_id LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = t.merchant_id LEFT JOIN linked_accounts la ON la.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN banks b ON b.bank_code = la.bank_code LEFT JOIN risk_evaluations re ON re.transaction_id = t.transaction_id WHERE w.user_id = #{wardId} AND t.status IN ('COMPLETED', 'REJECTED', 'CANCELED') ORDER BY t.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT t.transaction_id AS transactionId, CASE WHEN t.type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' THEN 'TRANSFER' ELSE t.type END AS type, CASE WHEN t.type = 'CHARGE' THEN 'IN' ELSE 'OUT' END AS direction, t.status AS status, re.risk_level AS riskLevel, CASE t.type WHEN 'CHARGE' THEN COALESCE(ib.name, b.bank_name) WHEN 'PAYMENT' THEN m.name WHEN 'TRANSFER_OUT' THEN r.holder_name END AS counterpartyName, CASE t.type WHEN 'CHARGE' THEN b.bank_name WHEN 'TRANSFER_OUT' THEN rb.bank_name END AS bankName, CASE WHEN t.type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' THEN r.account_no END AS accountNo, t.amount AS amount, t.memo AS memo, COALESCE(t.completed_at, t.created_at) AS occurredAt, t.balance_after AS balanceAfter, re.total_score AS riskScore FROM transactions t JOIN wallets w ON w.wallet_id = t.wallet_id LEFT JOIN recipients r ON r.recipient_id = t.recipient_id LEFT JOIN banks rb ON rb.bank_code = r.bank_code LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = t.merchant_id LEFT JOIN linked_accounts la ON la.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN banks b ON b.bank_code = la.bank_code LEFT JOIN users ib ON ib.user_id = t.initiated_by LEFT JOIN risk_evaluations re ON re.transaction_id = t.transaction_id WHERE t.transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND w.user_id = #{wardId}

SELECT t.transaction_id AS transactionId, CASE WHEN t.type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' THEN 'TRANSFER' ELSE t.type END AS type, CASE WHEN t.type = 'CHARGE' THEN 'IN' ELSE 'OUT' END AS direction, t.status AS status, re.risk_level AS riskLevel, CASE t.type WHEN 'CHARGE' THEN COALESCE(ib.name, b.bank_name) WHEN 'PAYMENT' THEN m.name WHEN 'TRANSFER_OUT' THEN r.holder_name END AS counterpartyName, CASE t.type WHEN 'CHARGE' THEN b.bank_name WHEN 'TRANSFER_OUT' THEN rb.bank_name END AS bankName, CASE WHEN t.type = 'TRANSFER_OUT' THEN r.account_no END AS accountNo, t.amount AS amount, t.memo AS memo, COALESCE(t.completed_at, t.created_at) AS occurredAt, t.balance_after AS balanceAfter, re.total_score AS riskScore FROM transactions t JOIN wallets w ON w.wallet_id = t.wallet_id LEFT JOIN recipients r ON r.recipient_id = t.recipient_id LEFT JOIN banks rb ON rb.bank_code = r.bank_code LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = t.merchant_id LEFT JOIN linked_accounts la ON la.account_id = t.account_id LEFT JOIN banks b ON b.bank_code = la.bank_code LEFT JOIN users ib ON ib.user_id = t.initiated_by LEFT JOIN risk_evaluations re ON re.transaction_id = t.transaction_id WHERE t.transaction_id = #{transactionId} AND w.user_id = #{wardId}

SELECT rr.rule_code FROM risk_evaluation_details red JOIN risk_rules rr ON rr.rule_id = red.rule_id JOIN risk_evaluations re ON re.evaluation_id = red.evaluation_id WHERE re.transaction_id = #{transactionId} ORDER BY red.score DESC
